description: An office supply company makes two types of printers: color printers and black and white printers. Different sections of the factory with different teams produce each printer. The color printer team can produce at most MaxColorPrinters per day while the black and white printer team can produce at most MaxBWPrinters per day. Both teams require use of the same paper tray installing machine and this machine can make at most MaxMachineCapacity printers of either type each day. Color printers generate a profit of ProfitColorPrinter per printer while black and white printers generate a profit of ProfitBWPrinter per printer. How many of each printer should be made to maximize the company's profit?

MaxColorPrinters.definition: Maximum number of color printers produced per day

MaxBWPrinters.definition: Maximum number of black and white printers produced per day

MaxMachineCapacity.definition: Maximum capacity of the shared paper tray installing machine per day

ProfitBWPrinter.definition: Profit per black and white printer

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing color printers and black and white printers"
